predictions.justification: PM demonstrates exceptional leadership across all threads: initiates strategic decisions, synthesizes feedback into clear direction, delivers artifacts on committed timelines, and drives convergence. Consistently frames problems, proposes solutions, and closes decisions with precision. Manages scope ruthlessly and keeps team aligned on priorities.

evidence.snippet: I've drafted the MVP vision for our subscription analytics product. I'm sharing the initial scope in A1 and want to get feedback
You're right, I think we're trying to do too much. Let me revise A1 to focus on the core analytics dashboard, basic segmentation, and reporting
I'll have A1 updated by tomorrow EOD with the locked feature set and success metrics. That should unblock everyone
D5 is locked—we're going with the three-tier model (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) with the feature matrix in A2

predictions.justification: BA consistently demonstrates high-impact contributions: identifies gaps in requirements (segment definition, success metrics), proposes concrete improvements, owns critical workstreams (T2, T8, T12), and coordinates across teams. Asks probing questions that drive clarity and provides actionable next steps. Delivers on commitments with precision.

evidence.snippet: I'd suggest we narrow it down to 2-3 specific segments based on revenue potential and implementation ease. Also, I notice the success metrics are a bit loose

I'll pull together the pilot feedback, identify the top improvement areas, and draft a roadmap for the next 2-3 releases

predictions.justification: Business consultant demonstrates strong analytical capability and business acumen: develops pricing models grounded in market research and customer value, negotiates discount thresholds pragmatically, and delivers financial models on schedule. Proactively addresses stakeholder concerns and refines proposals based on feedback. Owns critical business decisions.

evidence.snippet: I looked at comparable analytics products in the market and benchmarked against their pricing. I also factored in the value we're delivering—time savings, better insights
Let me propose a revised approach: Starter tier has no discounts, Professional allows up to 10% for annual commitments, Enterprise allows up to 20% with approval from finance

Executes well on assigned workstreams but contributes less to strategic analysis and problem-solving compared to PM and BA.
